goal: Prevent kernel consumers and external utilities from silently overwriting an active node's block files
Protect block storage integrity by locking the blocks directory whenever block storage is opened
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Verified fix and regression test reproduction across active block directories (KY-U)
Nonblocking suggestion to document the directory lock requirement in public kernel headers (KY-U)

why: P2 because it fixes a data corruption hazard where external tools overwrite active block files
